description: Fires when the leftmost column (column 0) is full or nearly full (4-6 stones, strongest at 6), especially when most of those stones belong to the player to move, the last move was into column 0, column 1 is short, and the game is still fairly short (under ~26 stones). Long games, opponent-dominated column 0, or many stones in column 1 suppress it. Other columns being tall does not trigger it.
effect: None measurable: forcing it high or off changes move probabilities by at most ~2 points (slightly lowers column 0 when column 0 still has room).
notes: Layer-0 unit. Core driver is stones in column 0 (columns 1-6 stacked give ~0). Modulated by ownership of col-0 stones (+), last move in col 0 (+), column-1 stones (-), and game length (-, strong past ply 26); some move-order/recency dependence in long games that a board program cannot capture. Dev F1 went 0.32 -> 0.37 -> 0.41 -> 0.46 -> 0.54 -> 0.63 (final, P 0.70 R 0.57, AUROC 0.78); simulation share 0.15. Two of eight score calls were accidental duplicates. Weights were hand-set from act probes, not fitted.
